g.text: Capital: Tokyo • Currency: Yen (JPY) • Time: JST UTC+9
Stylized geography, not to scale. City positions approximate along Honshu.

div.p: Japan is an archipelago of 14,125 islands off East Asia, where Shinto shrines sit beside neon skyscrapers. With 124 million people, it balances deep respect for craft, seasonality and hospitality (omotenashi) with world-leading robotics, transit punctuality and design minimalism.
Four main islands — Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu, Shikoku — hold 97% of the population. The Pacific Ring of Fire shapes its mountains, hot springs and cultural resilience.

foreignObject.div: Japan’s influence far exceeds its land area: it pioneered lean manufacturing, defined global pop culture from anime to J-pop, and maintains an extraordinary 72% forest cover. Its challenge now is demographic — super-aging, low birthrate — met with automation, regional revitalization and selective immigration, reshaping what homogeneity means.

div.p: Nominal GDP peaked at $5.12T in 2019. Yen depreciation since 2021 pushed dollar-denominated GDP down to $4.03T in 2024, even as domestic growth stayed resilient.
Strengths: autos, semiconductors materials, robotics, IP. Tokyo hosts the world’s largest metro economy.

div.div: In yen terms, GDP kept growing; dollar dip = FX effect, not output collapse.

g.text: Source: IMF World Economic Outlook. Drop after 2021 driven by JPY/USD.

foreignObject.div: Neon Shinjuku, serene Meiji Shrine, Tsukiji outer market, teamLab. Base for day trips.
1,600 temples, Arashiyama bamboo, Gion geiko lanes. Best at dawn before crowds.
Street food capital — takoyaki, okonomiyaki. Dotonbori, Umeda Sky, Nara nearby.
Peace Memorial, then floating torii gate. Oysters, maple-leaf momiji manju.
Fuji views from Lake Kawaguchi, onsen ryokan in Hakone, open-air museum.
Volcanoes, lavender fields in Furano, Sapporo beer, powder snow in Niseko.

g.text: Cherry late Mar–early Apr (south→north), autumn colors Nov. Book ryokan 3 months ahead.

Sources: IMF WEO (Apr 2024) for GDP • Statistics Bureau of Japan / Immigration Services Agency 2023 for nationality shares • UN WPP. Design: modern editorial, data viz not to strict scale. Map stylized.
